name: churn_leakage
note: Invented practice case: target-leakage diagnosis at a fictional mobile operator.

request.question: Looking at Exhibit 3, which data issue creates a risk of target leakage?
stated_figures: Me: First, the churn flag is set on the date the account is closed, which is usually 30 days after the customer called to cancel.
Me: Second, 8% of customers migrated from a legacy billing system 14 months ago and have no history before that.
